reading.body:
Meta Henrico Data Center's power capacity is not published. Research on this facility's specifications, opening date, investment, and building details could not be confirmed from available sources this session, and the specific location has not appeared in public records accessed so far. Revisit with additional research budget to establish baseline facts about this site.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities of which 23 publish power figures totaling 1375 megawatts. Meta Henrico Data Center does not rank among the 23 published capacity leaders in the state. Without a published power figure, this campus cannot be placed in Virginia's capacity hierarchy or assessed for its share of the state's announced AI infrastructure.

Meta operates a multi-billion dollar owned data center program and recently announced a ten billion dollar investment in a large AI data center in Louisiana powered by natural gas. Whether Meta Henrico Data Center is part of that expansion, what workloads it serves, when it came online, and what power it draws remain unconfirmed and require direct operator contact or fresh public records review.
